purpose: One canonical authoring context, command vocabulary, reversible transaction path and frontend capability contract for the native editor, explicit runtime editor, lightweight F3 developer overlay and automation.

creatorWorkflow.spawnRule: Spawn is not a separate studio or tool. Player Start, NPCs, animals and spawners are entity definitions/resources placed through the ordinary contextual Place workflow.
creatorWorkflow.playFromHereRule: Play From Here is an ephemeral runtime launch command and never rewrites the persistent Player Start.
creatorWorkflow.manualAuthoringRule: Raw atlas/tile overrides, brushes and prefabs use the same command/transaction spine as semantic authoring.

frontendProfiles.developerOverlay: lightweight F3 inspection, diagnostics, live reload, debug spawn and teleport only
frontendProfiles.runtimeDeveloperEditor: explicit in-game authoring mode; world/content authoring allowed, source-asset authority remains outside runtime

transactionRules: world mutations should execute through EditorCommandBus.execute_transaction or its future batch equivalent
typed transactions must be reversible and validate expected-before state before replay
legacy snapshot history remains supported during migration
new world mutation paths must not require UI-owned mutation semantics

firstMigratedRuntimeMutation.legacyBehavior: F3 P directly wrote SceneMap.spawn_x/spawn_y after snapshot capture
firstMigratedRuntimeMutation.newBehavior: F3 P builds EditTransaction::set_scene_spawn and executes it through EditorCommandBus.execute_transaction
firstMigratedRuntimeMutation.undoRedo: F3 now uses transaction-aware undo_world/redo_world while retaining snapshot compatibility

deferred: contextual entity palette and Player Start visual marker
